g.text: Annual Education Spending per Student (PKR, log scale)
Annual Education Spending Varies Widely Among Rural Punjab Households
Source: PSLM 2019-20. Sample: Punjab rural students (ed_total > 0, Rs 100 - 1,000,000). Weighted by hhweight.
